attempted_claim: Let Q2 be the 2-adic field, C2 its completed algebraic closure, and P1_Berk the Berkovich projective line over C2 with Siegel disks defined by analytic linearization. For the single quadratic rational map F_3(z)=(z^2+3*z)/(z+1) over Q2, which has degree 2 with 0 fixed of multiplier 3 satisfying |3|_2=1 where 3 is not a root of unity, infinity fixed of multiplier 1, and a pole at -1, decide the Siegel-boundary wandering dichotomy: either (A) prove that the Siegel linearization disk at 0 exists with an explicitly computed Lindahl-Herman-Yoccoz radius whose boundary carries no periodic point and that no wandering Berkovich Fatou component accumulates on that boundary, or (B) exhibit a named wandering Berkovich Fatou component U of F_3 with proved pairwise disjoint forward iterates accumulating on the Siegel-disk boundary together with an explicit Julia-set witness point on that boundary. A complete answer proves the exact-radius plus no-accumulation statement (A) for this named linearizable map, or proves (B) with the exact disk radius, boundary-orbit analysis, wandering-orbit disjointness, Fatou-component status, and Julia witness.
claim_type: Siegel-boundary wandering dichotomy for named map
decisive_failure: The exact Siegel radius (conjectured 2^{-3/2} from the resonance subsequence) is unproved due to massive 2-adic cancellation among convolution terms; consequently the boundary periodic-point clause and the wandering-component/Julia-witness clause of the dichotomy are both unresolved. Artifacts contain only finite-order exact data and an unproved conjecture, so no part of branch (A) or (B) is established.
